balls.text: top stuff from PK, he gets it full around the blockhole on leg, Irfan tries to have a go at it, can only drag it to the bowler
cannot get much on this full one angled in as he backs away outside leg
low full toss, turned to deep midwicket
slow bouncer, he checks the pull and drags it to fine leg
moves outside leg and swings, but PK follows him with a fullish one, rolls to off
makes room and scoops a low full toss over the bowler
high full toss, Irfan puts it away over short third
some width on a pitched up ball, but Irfan gets little timing on the lofted drive, he almost ends up hitting it straight to extra cover, a lot of confusion later, they decide not to run
flat-bats a shortish one but not much power on it, to long off
tries to force a pull, but it is not short enough, and he does not have a lot of room too, down to long on
now Awana gets it low and full on the stumps, dug out to long on
slaps a back of a length ball loopily in front of extra cover, who runs forward initially for the catch but cannot stop it as it bounces in front
outstanding, PK hits the blockhole once more, Agarkar backs outside leg, but can only squeeze it to third man
Irfan keeps another PK yorker out, on middle, he digs it out to off
forces a pitched up ball from outside off to long on
swing and a miss to a slow back of a length ball wide outside off
perfect from PK, yorker on off stump, Warner can't keep it out, he tried to drive it, it sneaked in under
Warner gets the boundary early in the over, drags the pull behind square leg
no pace on the length delivery, Warner pulls into the ground through square leg
slowish bouncer outside off, Warner lets it pass
slow length ball, he waits and turns it square off the pad
goes outside leg again, Harmeet angles it outside off, Irfan reaches out in vain
turned wide of fine leg
chance gone, Irfan backed away to leg and was in no position as he swatted at this back of a length ball outside of, top edge looped over midwicket, long on could not get to it in time
gets on the knee across the stumps and tries to help this fine down leg, cannot get much on it though
gets it away this time, for a single to the sweeper
quick and full just outside off, he cannot get bat to ball
low full toss angled in, Pathan almost yorks himself as he comes forward, thick inside edge to short fine
pitched up outside off, pushed to cover
pushes one angled in from round the stumps, to extra cover
fullish, flicked off the pad but straight to forward square leg
eases a full one to long on
Botha's charged out and lofted this with the turn, looked alright as it came off, but he's failed to hit it wide of long off moving to his left
low full toss hit back, bowler dives and parries it away
leading edge but wide of extra cover as he comes forward to a fullish one
works a full delivery to wide long on
dabs a length ball going across him, behind point
Mandeep takes another catch, Jadhav tries to go down the ground, but ends up slicing this length delivery, it goes swirling very high, Mandeep is under it with a few steps back from extra cover
pitched up and pushed to mid off
short once more as Jadhav walks out, but this is angled down leg
Harmeet gets another wicket, short ball once more, Juneja swivels and sends it straight to fine leg
flays at a length ball going across, and underedges it to the keeper, Gilly dives to save the boundary, but concedes the single with the throw
shortish, he drags it on the bounce to deep midwicket, just short of the man
Juneja gets the swat-drive past extra cover, long off gets around
drills a quicker and fuller one to long off
Warner gets some width and bends to smash it between long on and deep midwicket, that flew fast and flat
good length and angled in, turned through midwicket
swat-driven in Kohli fashion but straight to extra cover
angled in full on leg stump, popped back down the pitch, well short of the bowler to his right
comes forward and swats it to extra cover
pushed to the man at long off
started to walk out, but stopped as Hussey shortened it and got hit on the pad in the end
skips out and forces it with the spin past midwicket
angled in full from round the stumps, Warner wants to sweep, can't get hold of it, takes the single to fine leg
walks out and turns it down to long off
drags it short now, on leg stump, and Warner pulls it to the deep square leg rope
whips a tossed up ball from way outside off in front of square leg
flighted full on off, he's paddled it all the way into the fine leg boundary, Bhatt cannot stop it with the dive, Chawla doesn;t like that
good length and straightening on the pad, turned square
pushed through across the left-hander, he backs away and punches, finds extra cover on the edge of the circle
tossed up, but on leg stump, and Warner gets the slog sweep going over deep midwicket
off the inner part of the bat wide of midwicket as he tries to force it through
angled into the pad, straightens, pushed to midwicket
whips a pitched up ball to long on
cuts to the sweeper
skips out and drives, cannot beat extra cover
good over, this comes in quickly with the angle, inside edge onto pad as he pushes
tossed up googly now, he walks across and is hit on the pad as he tries to run it past short third, played for the away turn
runs it to short third, can;t get the single
shortish and spinning away outside off, but he slaps it close to extra cover, who dives and saves runs
flighted full again, he comes forward now to drive to long off
tossed up and skids across, Warner beaten on the cut
good length angled in, turned off the pad to fine leg
tossed up slower now, and much fuller, turned to long on
that was pushed through quick and straight, jabbed back to the bowler
driven hard wide of long off, but he keeps them to one
turns in from outside off, he awkwardly punches it to long off
pushes a length ball to long off

Harmeet has got his man finally, Sehwag wasn;t liking the lack of pace, came forward this time to try and drive, it wasn't full enough, and he's scooped it in front of extra cover, who's dived forward to take it low, he stands his ground as the fielder's not sure, replays show Mandeep is alright
length ball angled down leg, Sehwag misses
they have kept him quiet on these bouncers, cuts in sharply and hits him on the shoulder as Sehwag withdraws from a pull, Harmeet appeals again, for caught behind this time
slapped to the left of the sweeper
this came in on off stump from back of a length, but Sehwag hadn't committed at all, and was able to guide it late off the back foot, needed a diving stop at fine third man boundary
good length, he knocks it down to long on
another shout for lbw from Harmeet, but his angle was taking it down leg once more
pulls, not off the middle, but it beats mid on's dive, and runs into the boundary even after Mandeep gets a hand to it
direct hit needed, but Hussey misses at the non-striker's, Sehwag was struggling had it hit after a work to midwicket
bouncer, angled down the leg side, Sehwag crouches under it
beaten by the bounce as he tries to cut a short of a length ball late, not that wide too
stays on the crease to a length ball angled in, and turns it late behind square leg, almost gets him four, stopped just inside
swatted off the hip to the right of short fine leg, a dive keeps them to one
short once more, gets big on Sehwag, who misses as he swings wildly
that has just cleared the man at deep midwicket, Sehwag went to pull a short one nipping in, ended up scooping it high, but was safe in the end
goes fuller now, outside off and Sehwag lifts it straight down the ground
squeezes this length ball from close to off to backward point
appeal for lbw, but the length was going down leg easily with the angle, it swung in quite a bit, Sehwag missing as he tries to go over mid on
shortish and wide, cut away, but point saves runs with a dive
tighter still from Awana, back of a length holding the line on off, patted towards extra cover
can't get width to go through the off side, pushes this length ball to cover now
guides a good length ball angled across, to point
Awana bangs it in short again, this time it is right at the batsman, and Warner crouches under
the experiment doesn't work for DD, RVDM swings at a short and wide ball, and top-edges it to cover
beaten, he hasn't been comfortable with the line close to off stump, this one just left him from back of a length, and beat his waft
whips this slowish length delivery from off and middle behind square leg, and it is timed so well a slide is needed near the rope
slower one now on middle and leg, knocked square off the pad, they settle with one in the end
clobbered between extra cover and mid off, RVDM gets a pitched up delivery widish outside off and has a go at it
tries to turn this from off through midwicket, but cannot beat the fielder
length on off, pushed to the bowler
not much width, just short of a length, but Sehwag needs just those many inches to open the face and guide it past backward point
tight line, good length coming in on off, squeezed to backward point
that moved away and bounced from a length, Sehwag opened up in the crease and pushed at it, thick edge runs to third man
pitched up but on the pads, and another single to deep square
not wide enough to cut, he chops a short of a length ball to wide slip
widish, back of a length, loud roar as Sehwag gets off the mark with a steer to third man
angled in to the pads, good length, easily tucked to deep square
that stayed low, in the first over, Sehwag was back in the crease to a length ball that barely got up, managed to keep it out
good length and moving in, angles down the pads
low full toss swinging in to middle and leg, worked square
PK follows inswing with outswing, pitched up for the drive, Mahela obliges, and wide slip gobbles a straightforward catch
Mahela is away, walks out, and flicks it with the inswing over square leg
pitched up and now it holds its line a tad just outside off, defended
swings in full right away, Mahela covers it and pushes to mid off softly
tries to pull, chops it into the crease, and that is enough to get the winning single
neat, overpitched on middle and leg, Chawla whips it straight past the bowler
shortish, pulled without timing to square leg
makes some room outside leg and runs this length ball to third man
bouncer now, he lets it go
pacy length ball leaving him with the angle, he pushes, gets a thick edge along the ground past the keeper
short of a length, steered to third man
goes for another one, it is a slower length ball, and he's swiped it high and into deep midwicket's hands at the edge of the boundary
first six of the chase, Hussey gets front leg away and lifts a length ball high and straight
length ball, he flows forward into a drive to the sweeper
back of a length, widish, he slaps it over extra cover
quick bouncer from Nehra at 137.5 kph, Miller thinks of a pull initially, withdraws late as it rushes on
RVDM gets in a maiden, another punch to short extra cover off a quick and flat one
can't beat short extra cover as he punches off the back foot
punches this back down the track, bowler dives and parries it to short extra
backs away and cuts from middle and off, to point
quick one pushed to extra cover
goes back to a length ball that hurries on, jabs it back
whipped off the pad to deep midwicket
Nehra gets in the yorker, 140 kph, dug out down the pitch
length on the pads, turned past the bowler on leg for one
opens the face to a length ball and runs it to third man
bouncer, climbs outside off at 137.6 kph
back of a length and coming in, guided to point
steers to the right of third man who dives and keeps them to two
quick, short of a length and angled in, Hussey beaten as he backs away to leg
short into the body, he swivels for the pull but finds no timing on it, to deep square leg
comes out and is hit on the pads with a 145 kph length ball outside leg
beats him on the drive with a 144 kph length ball zipping across
full, he pushes away from the body, just past extra cover
quicker from round the stumps, he gets the stride and pushes hard, but short extra is in the way
fullish, whips it with the turn to long on
slow and tossed up, he waits and pats it down the pitch
nudged off the front foot to deep square leg
he's charged out, and had a go, off the inner part of the bat and into the boundary past deep midwicket
angled in full from round the stumps, he's turned it between deep midwicket and deep square leg for two
skips out, gets too close to the line, and drills a full toss to long off
goes back to whip it through midwicket
that'll go, on a length but widish, he goes back early and cuts it late and hard past short third man
fullish, driven straight to short extra cover
shortish, punched off the back foot to long on
turned to deep square leg
almost bowled him, almost, in the end, it's missed eveything, he pushed forward at this length ball, which beat the inside edge, sailed just over the stumps, and keeper couldn't stop it
pushed off the front foot to long off
pushed off the front foot wide of cover
full, turned down to long on
another one gone, Botha tosses it up, around off, Vohra tries the slog sweep and top edges it for the bowler to settle under it
Vohra gets going after the time out with a charge and a loft over mid off
full and angled in, flicked out to deep midwicket
does not quite time the pull to deep midwicket
pushed to extra cover, now Mahela has a go at the non-striker's end, misses
Warner goes for the non-striker's stumps again from point, but misses this time, Vohra would have been gone
mishits a punch to point off the bottom edge
pitched up on the pad, flicked in the air to fine leg
eased off the back foot wide of cover
pushed off the front foot to short extra cover, who dives to stop it
spins in from a length, he drags it in the air over midwicket
quicker and closer to off, blocked
tossed up ball outside off, defended off the front foot
tossed up high and full, driven to long off
whipped to deep midwicket off the pad
pushed for a quick single in front of point
floated up further, he is forward to defend, there is an appeal, but there was an inside edge
turn and bounce, angled in on off, and takes off past the outside edge
good stop at wide long on, it was lofted with a closed face over midwicket, Juneja threw himself to his left to pluck it on the bounce
pushed down the track
worked off the pad in front of square leg
slower one pitched up, he is on the front foot and adjusts to push to extra cover
superb timing, brings bat around front pad and clips a length delivery wristily past midwicket
reaches forward to drive a pitched up ball to extra cover
keeper goes up immediately for caught behind, bowler does no react after beating Miller on the cut with a pacy short of a length ball angled across
punches a back of a length ball to extra cover
overpitched, forced down to long on

what's happening, needless again from KXIP, Mandeep rushes out for the single after Miller nudges to square leg, there is a direct hit, Mandeep's bat ends up in the air as he dives and slides it in, he seemed to have grounded it just inside for a frame before it went up in the air as the bails came off, third umpire thinks otherwise, though
and next ball, he backs to leg, tries a heave, misses the length ball, and is bowled, needless
reverse sweep, Pomersbach is middling everything, length on off, he slams it past backward point
quick and fullish, dabs it to short third man for one
fine one-handed stop to his left by Mahela at extra cover, this was driven hard
moved outside leg a long way, Botha tried to follow him but he was still able to punch it past extra cover, whose dive took pace off it
overpitched, he forces it past the bowler, long off runs around to field
tossed up from round the stumps, pushed to leg close to the pitch
floated up full, down to mid off this time
popped down the pitch, as he gets a leading edge looking to turn it to leg
tossed up outside off, pushed down the pitch
outswinger, he watches it sail past harmlessly
shot, Pomersbach has jumped out and smashed this length ball between the non-striker and mid off
now Pomersbach, short and gentle from IK into the body, he swivels and picks it over square leg
now he swings it down the leg side, width, either side, nightmare start for DD
they keep feeding Mandeep with width, and he keeps putting them away through the covers
shortish and moving down the pads, Mandeep helps it fine along the corner off a bottom edge
swinging away from a good length, he waits and turns it to third man
skiddy length ball on off, he comes forward late and gets a thick inside edge to fine leg
gets it right fifth ball, back of a length close to off, pushed softly towards point
wide again and this could have gone too, but the infield is now more fortified, and a cut is stopped at point
horror start, Nehra, shortish and wide for the third time, Mandeep cracks it past cover
now full, and wide again, Mandeep comes forward and lofts over cover, one bounce over the boundary
starts short, and widish, Mandeep upper cuts it over point
waits for it to hold the line this time and turns it to midwicket
came forward, it swung in again, from a length, and bounced too, defended awkwardly from close to the splice
swings in a tad after starting across, left alone
another failure for Gilchrist, Irfan angles it in, Gilcrist wants to swing to leg, it moves away and the edge swirls high and comes down in Botha's hands at extra cover
another outswinger, good length this time, he drives, just clears extra cover
outside edge first ball, just past Sehwag;s dive at wide slip, outswinger angled in, he closed the face as he tried turning it to leg
